dialogues.speaker: Tetreaux
dialogues.text: Got a problem? I can solve it for you.

dialogues.speaker: Tetreaux
dialogues.text: Theoretically, I do not believe there is any problem that can only be solved by force.

dialogues.speaker: Tetreaux
dialogues.text: When we of the Spina di Rosula act, I'm certain that we'll be able to resolve your issue with minimal harm.

dialogues.speaker: Tetreaux
dialogues.text: From things as small as living supplies and household affairs, to matters as large as factional disputes and savings... the Spina will do all it can for you.

dialogues.speaker: Tetreaux
dialogues.text: Consider it no bother — we all help each other here.
